description: Scores a test utterance against a Cognigy.AI flow's trained NLU intents. Returns ranked intent matches with confidence scores. Use this to test NLU recognition before deployment.

flowReferenceId.description: The reference ID (UUID) of the flow to score against

localeReferenceId.description: The reference ID (UUID) of the locale

projectId.description: The project ID containing the flow

sentence.description: The test utterance to score against trained intents

name: generate_nlu_scores
